summary: Maris-Tech Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, presenting unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes balance sheet, income statement, equity changes, and cash flows. Balance sheet data show increased share issuance and conversion of promissory notes, but no transactional special situation is described. This is a routine periodic financial report, not a strategic corporate action.
